details.eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university (as per the SBI Clerk / Junior Associate notification on sbi.bank.in/web/careers).
details.pattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 60 minutes (English 30, Numerical Ability 35, Reasoning 35). Mains: 190 questions, 200 marks (General English 40, Quant 50, Reasoning & Computer Aptitude 50, General/Financial Awareness 50). Then Local Language Test. No interview.
details.syllabus: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, English Language, General/Financial Awareness, Computer Aptitude.
